# Feature `image:read-only-rootfs-delayed-postinsts`

Image feature `read-only-rootfs-delayed-postinsts`:

when specified in conjunction with `read-only-rootfs`, specifies that post-install scripts are still permitted (this assumes that the root filesystem will be made writeable for the first boot; this feature does not do anything to ensure that - it just disables the check for post-install scripts.)

Offline source: yocto-manuals/references/manuals/ref-manual/features.md (online: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/features.html#image-features)
